package bytesvalidation_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	service "example.com/bytesvalidation/gen/bytescheck"
	server "example.com/bytesvalidation/gen/jsonrpc/bytescheck/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

func TestRequestValidation(t *testing.T) {
	seen := make(chan *service.CheckPayload, 1)
	endpoints := &service.Endpoints{Check: func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
		seen <- p.(*service.CheckPayload)
		return nil, loom.Fault("observed")
	}}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil))
	hs := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer hs.Close()
	cases := []struct {
		name, params, errorName, message string
		code                             int
		called                           bool
	}{
		{"valid", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"optional\":\"aGV5\",\"chain\":\"aGk=\",\"choice\":\"aGk=\",\"items\":[\"aGk=\"],\"lookup\":{\"key\":\"aGk=\"},\"nullable\":\"aGk=\"}", "fault", "observed", -32603, true},
		{"minimum", "{\"data\":\"aA==\"}", "invalid_length", "validation error", -32602, false},
		{"maximum", "{\"data\":\"bG9uZw==\"}", "invalid_length", "validation error", -32602, false},
		{"missing", "{}", "missing_field", "Missing required field: data", -32602, false},
		{"enum", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"choice\":\"bm8=\"}", "invalid_enum_value", "invalid value", -32602, false},
		{"array", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"items\":[\"aA==\"]}", "invalid_length", "validation error", -32602, false},
		{"map", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"lookup\":{\"key\":\"aA==\"}}", "invalid_length", "validation error", -32602, false},
		{"nullable", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"nullable\":\"aA==\"}", "invalid_length", "validation error", -32602, false},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			body := "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":\"1\",\"method\":\"check\",\"params\":" + tc.params + "}"
			response, err := http.Post(hs.URL+"/rpc", "application/json", strings.NewReader(body))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			raw, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := response.Body.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var envelope struct {
				Error *struct {
					Code    int
					Message string
					Data    struct{ Name string }
				}
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope, json.MatchCaseInsensitiveNames(true)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if response.StatusCode != 200 || envelope.Error == nil {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.StatusCode, raw)
			}
			if envelope.Error.Code != tc.code || envelope.Error.Data.Name != tc.errorName || !strings.Contains(envelope.Error.Message, tc.message) {
				t.Errorf("body=%s", raw)
			}
			select {
			case got := <-seen:
				if !tc.called {
					t.Error("invalid request invoked service")
				}
				if string(got.Data) != "hi" || got.Defaulted != "hi" {
					t.Errorf("decoded payload=%+v", got)
				}
			default:
				if tc.called {
					t.Error("valid request did not invoke service")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
